_: Limits for scripts/release-check.sh, at 200 targets. A value outside fails the check; baseline.json holds the last release's numbers (twice as bad warns). Measured 2026-11-14 on an 8-core desktop: see the comments in doc/development.md.

fuzz.failures.why: no crash, leak, 5xx or broken invariant in 20 000 inputs of each kind

fuzz.labels_reached.why: the fuzz inputs got to every outcome (loaded/refused, 2xx/304/4xx)

scale.sent_all.why: every target got its cycle recorded

scale.live_probes_ratio.why: probes answered or given up within the window

scale.live_last_at_ms.why: the last probe inside the cycle (60 s, window 58 s)

scale.lo_rtt_max_ms.why: loopback RTT: the prober adds no delay of its own

scale.delta_gzip_bytes.why: what a page fetches per cycle

scale.live_2s_bytes.why: what a page fetches per live poll

scale.page_first_rows_s.why: page load to the first rows

scale.page_newstate_ms.why: a new cycle (every target's figures again)

scale.line_bg_chars.why: the probe line stays a few stops

load.findings.why: every answer as expected, no 5xx, no crash, no error in the log

load.peak_rss_mb.why: server memory under 150 viewers, a burst and slow readers

load.burst_served.why: of 400 at once, the 256 the server takes

load.live_p99_ms.why: live poll latency under load (client-bound, see doc)

serve.state_gzip_p99_s.why: 150 clients fetching the whole state at once

ui.scroll_height_change_px.why: a phone's URL bar does not move the list

ui.scroll_redraw_px.why: a redraw does not move the list
